## PRESS NOTE

The Department of Mines and Geology, Anakapalli, has issued orders
directing immediate stoppage of quarrying operations in respect of the Gravel
Quarry Lease over an extent of 2.153 Hectares in Sy.No.01 of Panchadarla Village,
Rambilli Mandal, Anakapalli District, granted in favour of M/s. Vijay Kumar Naidu
Dasamnani, pending completion of a comprehensive departmental survey and
detailed inspection.

The action has been taken after the Department received several
complaints from the public regarding the manner in which quarrying operations
were being carried out. During the inspection conducted by the officers of the
Department, it was prima facie noticed that quarrying operations had allegedly
extended beyond the sanctioned lease boundaries by encroaching into the
adjoining lands. It was also observed that quarry benches exceeding 8.00 metres
in height had been formed without obtaining prior permission from the competent
authority, contrary to the provisions of the A.P. Minor Mineral Concession Rules,
1966 and the conditions of the Quarry Lease.

In view of the nature of the complaints and the violations noticed during
inspection, the Department has decided to undertake a comprehensive survey
using modern survey techniques, including DGPS/ETS, to verify the lease
boundaries, assess the extent of excavation, ascertain whether any encroachment
has taken place beyond the leased area and examine compliance with the
statutory provisions governing quarrying operations.

The Department has also taken note of the report submitted by the
Assistant Director (Technical), Archaeology & Museums Department,
Visakhapatnam, following a joint field inspection conducted on 15.07.2026. The
report states that although the quarry is situated at a distance of about 1,000
metres from the protected Panchadarla Group of Temples, which are protected
under the Andhra Pradesh Ancient and Historical Monuments and Archaeological
Sites and Remains Act, 1960, continued quarrying operations and the vibrations
generated therefrom may potentially affect the ancient natural water channels
associated with the protected monument. The report has therefore recommended
that appropriate precautions be taken in the interest of protecting the heritage
monument and its associated features.

Accordingly, exercising the powers available under the provisions of the A.P.
Minor Mineral Concession Rules, 1966 and the conditions of the Quarry Lease
Deed, the District Mines & Geology Officer, Anakapalli, has ordered immediate
stoppage of all quarrying operations, including excavation, drilling, blasting,
loading and transportation of mineral from the lease area, until completion of the
detailed survey and further orders.
